message.reasoning_content:
The watch: Omega Constellation with Master Chronometer, Co-Axial, date at 6, silver/white dial with Roman numerals on bezel. This is the Omega Constellation 39mm Master Chronometer. Reference 131.10.39.20.02.001 (silver dial, steel bracelet). Let me think.

The Omega Constellation Master Chronometer 39mm steel: references 131.10.39.20.02.001 (silver/white dial), 131.10.39.20.06.001 (grey dial). Actually the "Globemaster" is different. The Constellation 39mm Master Chronometer was introduced in 2020 with caliber 8800.

The dial here is silver with baton hands, date at 6 o'clock, "Co-Axial Master Chronometer" text, and the Constellation star. Bezel with Roman numerals and claws... actually this version has the "claws" at 3 and 9 (griffes) — yes visible at the sides.

Reference: 131.10.39.20.02.001. Let me double-check format: Omega uses format like 131.10.39.20.02.001 — that's correct for the Constellation 39mm Master Chronometer with silver dial on steel bracelet.

Wait, is this 39mm or 41mm? The Constellation 41mm... Actually the Constellation Master Chronometer comes in 39mm (cal 8800) and 41mm (cal 8900). The 39mm is 131.10.39.20.02.001. The 41mm is 131.10.41.21.02.001? Hmm.

The dial printing "CO-AXIAL MASTER CHRONOMETER" and star below. The 39mm has date at 6. The 41mm also has date at 6? Actually the 41mm Constellation Master Chronometer has date at 3? No.

Let me think: The current Constellation 41mm Master Chronometer (ref 131.10.41.21.02.001 etc.) has date at 6 o'clock too? The 41mm version introduced 2024? Hmm, I recall the 41mm Constellation with date at 3.

Actually the Constellation 39mm Master Chronometer (2020) has small seconds? No, it has center seconds and date at 6.

I'll go with 131.10.39.20.02.001, steel, automatic, metal bracelet, confidence ~0.5.

Hmm, but the dial looks silver/white — 131.10.39.20.02.001 is "silver" dial. There's also 131.10.39.20.02.002? Let's just go.

Actually wait — dial appears white/silver with silvery baton hands, and the pattern... The 39mm silver dial reference is 131.10.39.20.02.001. I'll say confidence 0.45.

Movement: automatic (Co-Axial Master Chronometer Calibre 8800).

Case material: stainless steel. Bracelet: metal (steel bracelet with the Constellation's signature bar links).
